acceptance.payload: EP8 actual NVLink peer payload; EP16 deduplicated RDMA payload; exclude metadata and self copies

validation.pure_repeat_checks: 24 rounds for each of the four recorded cases
validation.qwen_buffer_modes: dynamic/static, skew and six FWD+BWD graph replays passed
validation.timing_use: Small full-GEMM runs are correctness checks only; some overlapped CPU compilation.

diagnostics.name: sender and receive timeline
diagnostics.finding: Last PUT 735 -> 551 us, last local Dispatch completion 900 -> 680 us; final received fanout still ~980 us. Compare only same-GPU timestamps.

diagnostics.name: GIN context allocation
diagnostics.finding: NCCL INFO confirms requested 3 / actual 3 data-communicator contexts on 8 local ranks. Shared backend contexts pass repeat correctness; diagnostic timings excluded.

diagnostics.name: Ready to receive claim latency
diagnostics.finding: Instrumented EP16 8K: median final critical receive ready 890.976 us, claim 913.536 us, end 971.328 us. Instrumented timeline is diagnostic only.

diagnostics.name: Cooperative received fanout timeline
diagnostics.finding: EP16 8K: first PUT 137.424 us, last PUT 526.752 us, last received fanout end 947.776 us; diagnostic only.

diagnostics.name: GIN pack sub-stages
diagnostics.finding: Median metadata 7.776 us, leader payload 28.064 us, final system fence and join 13.84 us. Final interval also includes waiting for other issuers; not isolated fence latency.

diagnostics.name: Strong versus weak credit signal
diagnostics.finding: Installed GDAKI ignores the strong/weak distinction in ncclGinApi_Put; switching credit action cannot remove a hidden flush here. No action-type change made.

notes: Selected common 64-row configuration passes both EP8 sizes and EP16 64K Dispatch/Return; EP16 8K Dispatch is 34.90 GB/s and remains below 40.
Small full-GEMM validation runs are correctness checks, not end-to-end performance evidence.
Native TMA waits, 128-row packets, 8/32 sender CTAs and coalesced startup readiness did not beat the selected configuration and were not retained.

rejected_experiments.recovery_priority_channels16: Fewer channels regressed both Dispatch sizes.
rejected_experiments.recovery_priority_lanes4: More issuers with one buffer had no material 8K benefit.
rejected_experiments.recovery_priority_lanes8: More issuers with smaller TMA segments had no material 8K benefit.
rejected_experiments.recovery_async_credit: CTA-local credit mailbox gained only 0.4% at 8K and 0.1% at 64K; reverted for simplicity.
rejected_experiments.recovery_receive_prefetch: Publisher preclaim mailbox regressed EP16 8K Dispatch from 963 to 1013 us; reverted.
rejected_experiments.recovery_all_local_dynamic: Dynamic local claims did not fix EP8 8K regression with 128-row batches (221 GB/s); reverted.
rejected_experiments.recovery_coop_prefetch_wide: Doubling staging requires reducing FC1 stages and did not improve 8K Dispatch; not retained.

recovery_release_once.qwen_buffer_modes: dynamic/static, skew and six FWD+BWD graph replays passed
